Prices and conditions. Every engagement is carried out by Dr. Lior Tabansky in person, at your home or office, with you present and in control of your credentials. Each price is fixed and agreed in writing before work begins. Terms as of 16 October 2026. The first step: Private Exposure Assessment Covers one main phone and one computer, iPad or second phone, on the same main account (Apple or Android), with the relevant identities, accounts, apps, permissions, recovery routes and shared services. Half a day in person, typically four hours. The visit completes the agreed intake, access mapping, diagnosis and approved urgent first aid, including removing a malicious app or profile where that can be done safely. Four hours is a guide; the visit completes its agreed scope. You receive a written exposure summary of what was reviewed, found and changed, what remains and the next steps, whether or not you continue. For Personal Shield for Two and Inner Circle, the first step covers the first person's devices. The other people are reviewed within the tier. The 30-day rule The ₪4,000 counts in full toward a tier whose work begins within 30 days of completion of the first step. You then pay the balance. Balances: Personal Shield ₪28,000 · Personal Shield for Two ₪41,000 · Inner Circle ₪66,000. After day 30, the tier is charged at its full price. Moving up a tier: if the first step shows the next tier is needed, you pay that tier's price less the ₪4,000 already paid, within the same 30 days. The first step counts once per engagement, also for a group. Larger households: the fixed price is set in writing after the first step, from ₪90,000, and the ₪4,000 counts toward it on the same 30-day terms. When a household needs more If the first step shows more than a tier includes, such as more people or devices, a second home, staff or company devices, Toza proposes the next tier, with its full allowance, before any work begins. Beyond Inner Circle, Toza sets one fixed price in writing. Each tier has one fixed price for everything within its allowance. Agreed additions are separate, and any added scope or price is agreed in writing before that work begins. Allowances in every tier Everyday devices (phone, computer, tablet or second phone): up to three per person, shared within the tier. Personal Shield three, Personal Shield for Two six, Inner Circle twelve. Security keys, supplied, configured and tested: Personal Shield two, Personal Shield for Two four, Inner Circle eight. One home network and router, in addition to the devices. The work covers accessible settings and authorized administration. Replacement hardware, further connected devices and additional locations are quoted separately. Essential migration covers identity, recovery routes and critical-service access where needed. Historical archives and bulk data migration are scoped separately. A follow-up visit after about four weeks. Questions answered by WhatsApp or Signal for 60 days (see the 60-day question line). Coordination with your lawyer or family office, if you authorize it. A private dated record for each person; home-network work is recorded separately. Inner Circle adds a review visit at twelve months. The 60-day question line Questions answered by WhatsApp or Signal within one working day, for 60 days from completion of the tier's work. For questions and guidance about the work done. New work is agreed and priced separately; urgent needs go through an urgent visit. After the 60 days, the line can continue through Annual Care. Annual Care For past clients, after the 60-day question line. Twelve months of: Questions answered by WhatsApp or Signal within one working day, as before A check visit in person: devices, accounts, recovery settings and keys re-checked, and your dated record updated A new or replaced phone or computer set up the same way A replacement security key if one is lost or broken First available appointments Coordination with your lawyer or family office, if you authorize it ₪12,000 a year for one person, ₪15,000 for two, ₪20,000 for a household of up to four. Paid yearly in advance. The term starts the day the 60-day question line ends. For a household of up to four, Annual Care covers up to two new or replaced devices and up to two replacement keys. For Inner Circle, the first Care term moves the check visit to about month six; the twelve-month review stays. Further keys and any replacement router are charged at cost. Added devices are scoped separately. Joining: within six months of the question line ending. After that, you start again with a first step (₪4,000), which counts in full toward Annual Care within 30 days. Renewal: at the published price at the time. The invoice is sent 30 days before the term ends, and the line stays open for 14 days while it is settled. Scoped and priced separately: new people; a new or second home; company devices or staff; devices beyond the original allowance; any incident, such as a suspected compromise; urgent visits, on the urgent terms below. Urgent visits Availability is confirmed before you pay. For an accepted urgent booking, arrival is within four hours of both Toza's acceptance and receipt of payment. The clock starts when both conditions are met. The four hours are an arrival commitment; the visit then runs its agreed course. Surcharge ₪4,800, added to the agreed base service price. At weekends or holidays the surcharge is ₪6,000, replacing the ordinary surcharge. Other charges apply only if separately agreed. Payment before work Every paid service follows three steps: a written scope and price (the work, inclusions, exclusions, price, agreed additions and payment terms); your explicit acceptance; receipt of payment. The work is then scheduled. This applies to the first step, each tier or its balance, Annual Care and any agreed addition. The first conversation is free and commits you to nothing.
